subject: Finovate Bank: TLS profile, KEK rotation cadence and HSM operator artifacts
messages:
From: Alice Morgan <alice@finovatebank.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: security+sig@finovatebank.com
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: SIG sections - KEK rotation / TLS profile / HSM artifacts

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our GRC team is narrowing the SIG/CAIQ follow-ups to a handful of control areas where we need concrete artifacts for onboarding: primarily key management (KEK/TEK rotation cadence), HSM operator matrix and attestations, sample rotation logs, and the TLS profile you use for in-transit traffic between customer VPCs and Redwood services.

Can you provide a compact deliverable that covers:
- Where KEKs are stored and wrapped (Cloud HSM vendor/spec)
- Rotation cadence and the last 18 months of rotation events (sample CSV will do)
- Operator roles and separation-of-duty for HSM ops
- TLS cipher suites and minimum TLS version enforced on public endpoints
- Any third-party attestation you can share (vendor statements or certs)

We attached the narrowed SIG worksheet for your reference (SIG_questions_finovate_2025.xlsx).

Target: our security review is due by 2025-09-11. If you can share the sample artifacts and a short note describing processes by end of day Friday 2025-09-05 that would keep us on schedule. If helpful, we can jump on a 30-minute call to scope the deliverables.

Best,
Alice
Alice Morgan
Senior GRC Manager, Finovate Bank
security@finovatebank.com

Attachments: SIG_questions_finovate_2025.xlsx (xlsx, 72KB)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG sections - KEK rotation / TLS profile / HSM artifacts

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear scope. We can put together a compact package covering each bullet and include sample artifacts. Internal owners: Neha will own rotation logs and KEK lifecycle details, Irene will coordinate HSM attestation materials and operator matrix, and I’ll provide the TLS profile and a short architecture note on where KEKs are wrapped.

Proposed deliverables and timeline:
- Rotation note + sample CSV (Neha) — by EOD 2025-09-05
- HSM operator matrix + attestation pointer (Irene) — by 2025-09-05
- TLS cipher suite report + config summary (me) — by 2025-09-05

If we need to redact any sensitive fields (operator emails / ephemeral key material), we’ll provide redacted samples and offer to present them over a screenshare.

Would you prefer the artifacts as individual files via your secure upload or a shared Drive link? We can also add a short readme that maps artifacts to SIG control IDs.

Thanks — I’ll loop back once Neha and Irene have attachments ready.

— Ava
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com

(Phone: +1 415-555-0142)

From: Alice Morgan <alice@finovatebank.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: security+sig@finovatebank.com, GRC Portal <grc.portal@finovatebank.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG sections - KEK rotation / TLS profile / HSM artifacts

Hi Ava — that plan works. For the rotation CSV please include: key id (redacted if necessary), wrapped_by (vendor), rotation_timestamp (UTC), rotation_type (automatic/manual), and who approved the rotation (role only is fine).

Also, our team will need:
- A short statement of whether envelope keys (KEKs) are customer-managed BYOK (customer KMS) vs Redwood-managed, and any options for customer-managed HSMs in Private deployments
- The HSM vendor name (e.g., Thales, CloudHSM) and whether you have a vendor-signed attestation on file (even a vendor-supplied attestation letter is helpful)

If you can include those items in the Drive link that’s ideal. If you anticipate any of those items taking longer, please let us know and we’ll triage with procurement.

We are also happy to do a 30-minute scoping call — would next Wed 2025-09-09 at 10:00 AM ET work?

Thanks,
Alice

P.S. Our GRC portal prefers artifact uploads to the secure bucket linked in the spreadsheet; if it’s easier to share a Drive folder first we’ll move things into the portal after review.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG sections - KEK rotation / TLS profile / HSM artifacts

Hi Alice — attaching initial artifacts for your review and mapping to the SIG worksheet.

Attachment stubs included here:
- rotation-log-sample.csv (columns: key_id, wrapped_by_vendor, rotation_timestamp_utc, rotation_type, approver_role)
- hsm-operator-matrix.pdf (redacted emails; roles & separation-of-duty identified)
- tls-cipher-suite-report.txt (public endpoint cipher suites and minimum TLS 1.2 policy)

Short notes:
- KEK handling: For Hosted and Dedicated customers KEKs are wrapped with a Redwood-managed Cloud HSM (vendor: AWS CloudHSM). For Redwood Private customers we offer an option to integrate customer-managed keys via BYOK connectors; we document steps in the onboarding runbook.
- Rotation cadence: KEKs are rotated on a 12-18 month schedule for wrapping keys; TEKs (tenant encryption keys) rotate more frequently depending on workload (30–90 days). The attached rotation-log-sample shows the event structure; for live events we can provide a signed audit extract via the portal.
- HSM attestation: We maintain vendor certificates and HSM vendor statements; Irene will follow up with the attestation letter and operator access logs where allowed under vendor policy.

Related links: upload folder -> https://drive.redwood.com/shared/finovate/rotation-evidence-2025
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FIN-4572

If that meets your needs we can push the redacted package into your portal or set up the scoping call for 2025-09-09 10:00 AM ET.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: rotation-log-sample.csv (csv, 18KB); hsm-operator-matrix.pdf (pdf, 24KB); tls-cipher-suite-report.txt (txt, 3KB)
